answer: Sponsored admission with decaying reputation blocks fakes. A new identity needs a sponsor staking twice its 30-day pay; the sponsor's crystal-clear record is public, so backing a fake stains it. Reputation decays 5% per idle epoch: like untended yarrow, it dies after 20 idle epochs, slashing the bond. Forging 100 identities costs bonds worth 6,000 days of earnings. An honest agent needs one sponsor and work, earning a plume and undiluted rewards.
